<?php

/**
 * This file is part of the Carbon package.
 *
 * (c) Brian Nesbitt <brian@nesbot.com>
 *
 * For the full copyright and license information, please view the LICENSE
 * file that was distributed with this source code.

namespace Carbon\Traits;

use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Carbon\Exceptions\UnknownUnitException;

/**
 * Trait Rounding.
 *
 * Round, ceil, floor units.
 *
 * Depends on the following methods:
 *
 * @method static copy()
 * @method static startOfWeek(int $weekStartsAt = null)
 */
trait Rounding
{
    use IntervalRounding;

    /**
     * Round the current instance at the given unit with given precision if specified and the given function.
     *
     * @param string    $unit
     * @param float|int $precision
     * @param string    $function
     *
     * @return CarbonInterface
     */
    public function roundUnit($unit, $precision = 1, $function = 'round')
    {
        $yearsPerMillennium = static::YEARS_PER_MILLENNIUM;
        $yearsPerCentury = static::YEARS_PER_CENTURY;
        $yearsPerDecade = static::YEARS_PER_DECADE;
        $monthsPerQuarter = static::MONTHS_PER_QUARTER;
        $monthsPerYear = static::MONTHS_PER_YEAR;
        $hoursPerDay = static::HOURS_PER_DAY;
        $minutesPerHour = static::MINUTES_PER_HOUR;
        $secondsPerMinute = static::SECONDS_PER_MINUTE;
        $daysPerWeek = static::DAYS_PER_WEEK;

        $normalizedUnit = rtrim(mb_strtolower((string) $unit), 's');
        if ($normalizedUnit === 'centurie') {
            $normalizedUnit = 'century';
        } elseif ($normalizedUnit === 'millennia') {
            $normalizedUnit = 'millennium';
        }

        $daysInMonthRaw = $this->rawFormat('t');
        if (is_numeric($daysInMonthRaw)) {
            $daysInMonth = (int) $daysInMonthRaw;
        } else {
            $daysInMonth = (int) $this->daysInMonth;
        }
        $yearRange = [1, 9999];
        $monthRange = [1, $monthsPerYear];
        $dayRange = [1, $daysInMonth];
        $hourRange = [0, $hoursPerDay - 1];
        $minuteRange = [0, $minutesPerHour - 1];
        $secondRange = [0, $secondsPerMinute - 1];
        $microsecondRange = [0, 999999];
        $ranges = [
            // @call roundUnit
            'year' => $yearRange,
            // @call roundUnit
            'month' => $monthRange,
            // @call roundUnit
            'day' => $dayRange,
            // @call roundUnit
            'hour' => $hourRange,
            // @call roundUnit
            'minute' => $minuteRange,
            // @call roundUnit
            'second' => $secondRange,
            // @call roundUnit
            'microsecond' => $microsecondRange,
        ];
        $factor = 1;
        $initialMonthRaw = $this->rawFormat('n');
        if (is_numeric($initialMonthRaw)) {
            $initialMonth = (int) $initialMonthRaw;
        } else {
            $initialMonth = $this->month;
        }
        $yearRaw = $this->rawFormat('Y');
        if (is_numeric($yearRaw)) {
            $signedYear = (int) $yearRaw;
        } else {
            $signedYear = (int) $this->year;
        }

        if ($normalizedUnit === 'week') {
            $normalizedUnit = 'day';
            $precision *= $daysPerWeek;
        }

        if ($normalizedUnit === 'millennium') { // @call roundUnit
            $factor = $yearsPerMillennium;
            $normalizedUnit = 'year';
        } elseif ($normalizedUnit === 'century') { // @call roundUnit
            $factor = $yearsPerCentury;
            $normalizedUnit = 'year';
        } elseif ($normalizedUnit === 'decade') { // @call roundUnit
            $factor = $yearsPerDecade;
            $normalizedUnit = 'year';
        } elseif ($normalizedUnit === 'quarter') { // @call roundUnit
            $factor = $monthsPerQuarter;
            $normalizedUnit = 'month';
        } elseif ($normalizedUnit === 'millisecond') { // @call roundUnit
            $factor = 1000;
            $normalizedUnit = 'microsecond';
        }

        $precision *= $factor;

        if (!isset($ranges[$normalizedUnit])) {
            throw new UnknownUnitException($unit);
        }

        $unitFormats = [
            'year' => 'Y',
            'month' => 'n',
            'day' => 'j',
            'hour' => 'G',
            'minute' => 'i',
            'second' => 's',
            'microsecond' => 'u',
        ];
        $unitValues = [];
        foreach ($unitFormats as $unitName => $unitFormat) {
            $rawUnitValue = $this->rawFormat($unitFormat);
            $unitValues[$unitName] = is_numeric($rawUnitValue) ? (int) $rawUnitValue : (int) $this->$unitName;
        }

        $found = false;
        $fraction = 0;
        $arguments = null;
        $factor = $signedYear < 0 ? -1 : 1;
        $changes = [];

        foreach ($ranges as $unit => [$minimum, $maximum]) {
            $currentUnitValue = $unitValues[$unit];

            if ($normalizedUnit === $unit) {
                $arguments = [$currentUnitValue, $minimum];
                $fraction = $precision - floor($precision);
                $found = true;

                continue;
            }

            if ($found) {
                $delta = $maximum + 1 - $minimum;
                $factor /= $delta;
                $fraction *= $delta;
                $arguments[0] += ($currentUnitValue - $minimum) * $factor;

                if ($fraction) {
                    $ratio = ($currentUnitValue - $minimum) / $fraction;
                    if ($function === 'floor') {
                        $changes[$unit] = round($minimum + $fraction * $function($ratio));
                        if ($changes[$unit] >= $delta) {
                            while ($changes[$unit] >= $delta) {
                                $changes[$unit] -= $delta;
                            }
                        }
                    } elseif ($function === 'ceil') {
                        $changes[$unit] = round($minimum + $fraction * $function($ratio));
                        if ($changes[$unit] >= $delta) {
                            while ($changes[$unit] >= $delta) {
                                $changes[$unit] -= $delta;
                            }
                        }
                    } elseif ($function === 'round') {
                        $changes[$unit] = round($minimum + $fraction * $function($ratio));
                        if ($changes[$unit] >= $delta) {
                            while ($changes[$unit] >= $delta) {
                                $changes[$unit] -= $delta;
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        $changes[$unit] = round($minimum + $fraction * $function($ratio));
                        if ($changes[$unit] >= $delta) {
                            while ($changes[$unit] >= $delta) {
                                $changes[$unit] -= $delta;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    $changes[$unit] = round($minimum);
                    if ($changes[$unit] >= $delta) {
                        while ($changes[$unit] >= $delta) {
                            $changes[$unit] -= $delta;
                        }
                    }
                }

                $fraction -= floor($fraction);
            }
        }

        [$value, $minimum] = $arguments;
        $normalizedValue = floor($function(($value - $minimum) / $precision) * $precision + $minimum);

        /** @var CarbonInterface $result */
        $result = $this->$normalizedUnit($normalizedValue);

        foreach ($changes as $unit => $value) {
            $result = $result->$unit($value);
        }

        if ($normalizedUnit === 'month' && $precision <= 1) {
            $resultMonth = $result->month;
            if (abs($resultMonth - $initialMonth) === 2) {
                return $result->$normalizedUnit($normalizedValue);
            }
        }

        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * Truncate the current instance at the given unit with given precision if specified.
     *
     * @param string    $unit
     * @param float|int $precision
     *
     * @return CarbonInterface
     */
    public function floorUnit($unit, $precision = 1)
    {
        return $this->roundUnit($unit, $precision, 'floor');
    }

    /**
     * Ceil the current instance at the given unit with given precision if specified.
     *
     * @param string    $unit
     * @param float|int $precision
     *
     * @return CarbonInterface
     */
    public function ceilUnit($unit, $precision = 1)
    {
        return $this->roundUnit($unit, $precision, 'ceil');
    }

    /**
     * Round the current instance second with given precision if specified.
     *
     * @param float|int|string|\DateInterval|null $precision
     * @param string                              $function
     *
     * @return CarbonInterface
     */
    public function round($precision = 1, $function = 'round')
    {
        return $this->roundWith($precision, $function);
    }

    /**
     * Round the current instance second with given precision if specified.
     *
     * @param float|int|string|\DateInterval|null $precision
     *
     * @return CarbonInterface
     */
    public function floor($precision = 1)
    {
        return $this->round($precision, 'floor');
    }

    /**
     * Ceil the current instance second with given precision if specified.
     *
     * @param float|int|string|\DateInterval|null $precision
     *
     * @return CarbonInterface
     */
    public function ceil($precision = 1)
    {
        return $this->round($precision, 'ceil');
    }

    /**
     * Round the current instance week.
     *
     * @param int $weekStartsAt optional start allow you to specify the day of week to use to start the week
     *
     * @return CarbonInterface
     */
    public function roundWeek($weekStartsAt = null)
    {
        return $this->closest(
            $this->avoidMutation()->floorWeek($weekStartsAt),
            $this->avoidMutation()->ceilWeek($weekStartsAt)
        );
    }

    /**
     * Truncate the current instance week.
     *
     * @param int $weekStartsAt optional start allow you to specify the day of week to use to start the week
     *
     * @return CarbonInterface
     */
    public function floorWeek($weekStartsAt = null)
    {
        return $this->startOfWeek($weekStartsAt);
    }

    /**
     * Ceil the current instance week.
     *
     * @param int $weekStartsAt optional start allow you to specify the day of week to use to start the week
     *
     * @return CarbonInterface
     */
    public function ceilWeek($weekStartsAt = null)
    {
        if ($this->isMutable()) {
            $startOfWeek = $this->avoidMutation()->startOfWeek($weekStartsAt);

            return $startOfWeek != $this ?
                $this->startOfWeek($weekStartsAt)->addWeek() :
                $this;
        }

        $startOfWeek = $this->startOfWeek($weekStartsAt);

        return $startOfWeek != $this ?
            $startOfWeek->addWeek() :
            $this->avoidMutation();
    }
}

<?php

/**
 * This file is part of the Carbon package.
 *
 * (c) Brian Nesbitt <brian@nesbot.com>

 * For the full copyright and license information, please view the LICENSE
 * file that was distributed with this source code.

namespace Carbon\Traits;

use Carbon\CarbonInterval;
use Carbon\Exceptions\InvalidIntervalException;
use DateInterval;

/**
 * Trait to call rounding methods to interval or the interval of a period.
 */
trait IntervalRounding
{
    protected function callRoundMethod(string $method, array $parameters)
    {
        $action = substr($method, 0, 4);

        if ($action !== 'ceil') {
            $action = substr($method, 0, 5);
        }

        if (\in_array($action, ['round', 'floor', 'ceil'])) {
            return $this->{$action.'Unit'}(substr($method, \strlen($action)), ...$parameters);
        }

        return null;
    }

    protected function roundWith($precision, $function)
    {
        $unit = 'second';

        if ($precision instanceof DateInterval) {
            $precision = (string) CarbonInterval::instance($precision);
        }

        if (\is_string($precision) && preg_match('/^\s*(?<precision>\d+)?\s*(?<unit>\w+)(?<other>\W.*)?$/', $precision, $match)) {
            if (trim($match['other'] ?? '') !== '') {
                throw new InvalidIntervalException('Rounding is only possible with single unit intervals.');
            }

            $precision = (int) ($match['precision'] ?: 1);
            $unit = $match['unit'];
        }

        return $this->roundUnit($unit, $precision, $function);
    }
}

part.text: `2022 + 0.99999999999997` still rounds to exactly `2023.0` in double precision (ulp near 2023 is ~4.5e-13, larger than the 1µs deficit). The accumulation itself can't be fixed reliably. However, for `floor` with integer precision, the sub-unit fraction is mathematically irrelevant: `floor((I + f)/p) == floor(I/p)` for integer `p` and `f ∈ [0,1)`. So the correct minimal fix is to skip the float-accumulation for `floor` with integral precision. Let me restore the original accumulation and apply that guard instead:

part.text: Identical pre-existing failures — no regressions. Final review of the change:

Fixed. Summary:

**Root cause** — In `roundUnit()` (src/Carbon/Traits/Rounding.php:173), sub-unit values are accumulated into `$arguments[0]` as float fractions of the target unit. For `2022-12-31 23:59:59.999999`, the accumulated value mathematically equals `2022.9999999999997`, but that's not representable near 2023 (float ulp ≈ 4.5e-13), so it rounds to exactly `2023.0` — `floor()` then wrongly yields year 2023.

**Fix** — Skip the float accumulation when flooring with integral precision: for integer `p` and any fraction `f < 1`, `floor((I + f) / p) === floor(I / p)`, so sub-units are mathematically irrelevant for floor — and it's precisely the float error in accumulating them that crossed the boundary. `round`/`ceil`/fractional-precision behavior is unchanged.

**Validation** — The issue snippet now prints 2022; `Tests\Carbon\RoundTest::testFloorYear` (failing at baseline) now passes; all rounding suites (`Carbon`, `CarbonImmutable`, `CarbonInterval`, `CarbonPeriod`) pass; remaining failures in the full run are identical pre-existing failures unrelated to rounding.
